issues.desc: background.md Conversational Texture uses "full-3x2" without defining the abbreviation; a standalone reader unfamiliar with the Lattice authority proof terminology cannot infer what 3x2 means from the text alone

background.md Key Insights references "spec Section 4.2" without naming the file path (docs/parallel-decomposition-spec.md); the index.json description does name it, but the background alone leaves a new reader to infer which file "the spec" refers to
